_comment: Stage 5 decision-engine settings. Capacities are EXPERIMENTAL scenarios (share of eligible blocks inspected per week), not NYC budgets. One inspection slot = one block.
tie_break: deterministic splitmix64 hash of (block_id, origin), ascending (Stage 4 convention)

diversification.rationale: Pre-specified (not tuned on outcomes): no ZIP may receive more than 3x its share of eligible blocks in a weekly list, limiting concentration driven by reporting propensity while leaving most of the ranking intact.

policy_design._comment: Pre-registered BEFORE any validation-period prediction was generated (2026-10-24). Decisions use validation weeks 2025-01-06..2025-06-30 only; test results are reported afterwards and never feed back.
policy_design.objective: unique qualifying reports captured, outcome = any candidate block of the report inspected (multi_block label_reports)
policy_design.non_adjacent_rule: adopt for the primary policy only if it increases validation unique-report capture at EVERY configured capacity
policy_design.list_comparison: report whether the strict-target list captures more unique reports than the multi_block list at every capacity

_dashboard_default_note: Default inspection list: strict_topk (strict single-block LightGBM top-K; best under expected/assigned capture and never worse than plain top-K under any capture definition). multi_nonadj and strict_nonadj stay selectable comparisons. Display choice only.
_policy_design_note: The policy_design rule above was registered before validation predictions existed but after test-period top-K results were available, and its objective (any-candidate capture) favours the non-adjacent rule by construction. Under fractional/assigned-block capture the non-adjacent lists capture fewer reports (see outputs/stage5/capture_definitions.csv after running 'stage5 capture-definitions'). dashboard_default_list options: multi_nonadj | strict_topk | strict_nonadj.

volume.target: unique Brooklyn Street Condition/Pothole reports with Brooklyn evidence created in [t, t+7) (Stage 3 label_weeks.located_brooklyn_reports)

capacity_guidance.rule: pre-specified: if the forecast's upper interval bound exceeds the 75th percentile of the last 52 matured weekly volumes use the high scenario; if the forecast is below their 25th percentile use the low scenario; otherwise the middle scenario
